name: evoc_bench_20newsgroups
description: A variant of the classic 20 Newsgroups text-classification benchmark intended to evaluate classification performance (and possibly robustness) on 20 topical categories. It measures how well models assign the correct newsgroup label to documents, often used to test embedding/classifier quality and resistance to distributional or adversarial shifts.
reputation: Based on a well-known classical dataset (20 Newsgroups); the specific 'evoc' variant is a niche/derived benchmark with modest adoption.
